DRSQA_12292_Data.Label: ExpectedResponse
DRSQA_12292_Data.Value: To reduce incident noise for ML-based situations in BMC Helix AIOps, you can enable the Incident Noise Reduction feature, which consolidates multiple incidents into a single incident per situation and helps improve MTTR. Follow these steps: Log in to the BMC Helix AIOps console. Click on Services. Select the service for which you want to enable noise reduction. From your browser's URL, copy the service key for that service. In your configuration, specify the service keys for which you want to enable noise reduction, including a value for the show_policy_based_situations parameter. Set include to enable noise reduction for those service keys. After these steps, incident noise for ML-based situations on the selected services will be reduced by consolidating related incidents into a single incident for each situation.
